name: Appeal
overview: The topic of Appeal, as illustrated in Acts 25, centers on the Apostle Paul's legal defense and his strategic use of his right as a Roman citizen to appeal to Caesar. Paul asserts his innocence before Festus and the Jewish accusers, declaring that he has committed no offense deserving death and therefore appeals to Caesar for judgment. This appeal leads to a formal hearing before King Agrippa, highlighting Paul's reliance on lawful authority and his trust in God's sovereign plan through established legal channels.
